contentHtml:
TREATMENT

Skin Rejuvenation & Anti-Ageing in Ghaziabad

Glow, tighten and turn back time with medical-grade aesthetics.

Overview

Our signature glow programme blends Hydrafacial, medi-facials, chemical peels, skin boosters, microneedling RF and laser toning — meticulously layered to restore radiance, even tone, and firmness.

Key benefits

  • Visibly brighter, even-toned skin
  • Reduces pigmentation, tan & dullness
  • Tightens pores & boosts collagen
  • Zero downtime — pre-event ready
  • Customised to your skin goals

Who should opt

  • Dull, tired or pigmented skin
  • Pre-bridal & event glow
  • Anyone wanting preventative anti-ageing

The Procedure

01

Skin analysis & customised plan

02

Deep cleanse + exfoliation

03

04
